text:
erin (PM): Quick capture — final decisions well surface in the GA one-pager. Need closure on SLA measurement, credit formula, docs gating, support SLOs, observability sampling, pricing posture (preview vs committed), and EU data residency notes.
carlos (Eng): Implementation notes: we can hit p50~130ms and p95~380ms for documented "standard" prompt shapes if we enforce batching and KV cache. Long-context cases will vary; recommend shipping with a soft token-cap of 2k for GA to avoid tail blowups.
mira (SRE): SLA proposal: monthly availability objective = 99.9% measured as successful responses (2xx/3xx) excluding scheduled maint. Define outage as sustained 5xx rate >0.4% for 10m OR streaming timeouts >20s. Credits formula we propose: (minutes_unavailable / total_minutes_in_month) * impacted-month-invoice, capped. I'll post the formula with examples.
sophie (Docs): Docs gating: require public Quickstart, a short SLA explainer paragraph, and a 2-page Troubleshooting FAQ + minimal public runbook excerpt at GA. Full internal runbook (incident flows, escalations, runbook actions) to follow within 10 business days. Estimate ~3 writer-days for public pieces.
andre (FinOps): Pricing stance: mark self-serve as "indicative" for GA. Committed/discount tiers are available by contract only; we need 2 business days of E2E billing tests before publishing committed pricing. We'll run shadow billing during the canary.
claire (Legal): Standard legal positions: credit-only remedies capped at impacted-month invoice, 30-day notice for breaking API changes, and force majeure carveout. I need the exact sentence for "service unavailability" to sign off.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout at 4% traffic. Observability: no regressions detected so far. :eyes:
erin (PM): Draft decision to lock for roadmap one-pager: SLA objective 99.9% monthly; p95 per-route target 400ms (guideline); outage definition per Mira above; credits capped as Claire described. Docs: Quickstart + SLA explainer + 2pg FAQ required at GA; internal runbook within 10 business days. Support SLOs: P1 first-response 1h business hours / 4h off-hours; avoid hard TTR commitments first 30 days. Monitoring minima: p50/p95 per-route, token-cost per-model, per-route error-rate, cache-hit rate; alerts: 1) p95 > baseline * 1.8 for 5m, 2) 5xx >0.5% for 10m, 3) cache-hit <65% for 15m, 4) synthetic failure in >=2 regions. Pricing: indicative self-serve; committed pricing by contract. Data residency: note EU customers will be offered Private or Dedicated for strict residency; add a short callout in GA one-pager.
carlos (Eng): +1 from eng. I'll add token-cap enforcement and golden-synthetic probes PRs today.
mira (SRE): +1 pending I post the precise credits math and the retention ask (90d traces, 365d incident metadata). I'll also share the alert thresholds dashboard.
sophie (Docs): +1. I'll draft the 2-page FAQ + SLA explainer and a one-paragraph public runbook excerpt by EOD.
andre (FinOps): +1. I'll coordinate shadow billing during canary and the E2E billing test once canary scales.
claire (Legal): +1 pending the finalized outage sentence. I'll propose wording in 2 hours.
erin (PM): Great — I'll assemble the one-pager and include a "known-unknowns" section: billing E2E completion, legal exact wording, EU residency packaging. If the canary raises alarms call it out here and we'll pause rollout. :white_check_mark:
